purpose: Test whether the official PGN /v1/metadata/{filename} route can return non-radiance metadata for an exact Pandora209s2 filename that was already surfaced by the public static L0 directory, without requesting the raw L0 child file or any /v1/download route.

selection.rule: chronologically earliest exact scientific child filename in the frozen complete L0 names inventory

permittedResponseUse: quality metadata that does not expose target radiance values
declared type/unit/wavelength/filter/uncertainty semantics without target spectral samples
forbiddenResponseUse: per-pixel target uncertainty arrays if coupled to target spectral values
brightness-, spectrum-shape-, residual-, or model-agreement-based selection
failClosedIf: route redirects to /v1/download or another non-metadata endpoint
response contains a target measurement array or target spectral sample payload
API requires opening the raw L0 file to answer the metadata request
filename is rewritten to a guessed L1 filename
